explanation: Repeatedly merge the two least-weight trees. Traverse the resulting tree to assign explicit binary code strings, then sum frequency×code-length and divide by 100.
timeComplexity: O(n log(n+1)+S), where S is the sum of codeword lengths
spaceComplexity: O(n+S) tree/code storage; S can be O(n²)
